due_when.clears_when: _cancel_oca_group_for_symbol returns verify_state 'unreadable' when ib.openTrades() raises, with a test, and place_protective's handling of that state is decided and tested

origin.rerun: grep -n 'def _cancel_oca_group_for_symbol' -A40 src/units/accounts/ib_client.py | grep -n '_open_trades'  # a hit => still open

what: IBClient._cancel_oca_group_for_symbol (src/units/accounts/ib_client.py, the keyed pre-cancel in place_protective) still reads the book via _open_trades, which swallows an ib.openTrades() failure into [] -- the same 'could not read' == 'nothing resting' collapse PR #15306 fixed for _cancel_resting_orders_for_symbol (ORDER-AUDIT-2 item 4). Consequence here is narrower (place_protective arms a fresh bracket beside one it could not see -> possible double protection, not a reverse fill), so it was left out of that PR. Fix: same direct read + verify_state 'unreadable', and place_protective should not arm a second bracket on 'unreadable'.
